# authsignal_message_overrides (Data Source)

Retrieves a tenant's currently configured pre-built UI message overrides.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve the tenant's current message overrides. No values are needed.
data "authsignal_message_overrides" "current" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `overrides` (Map of Map of String) Override copy keyed by locale (e.g. `en`, `pt-br`), then by message override ID (e.g. `sms-code-entry.heading`).
